lots.title: RCV's
lots.description: Refuse collection vehicles (RCVs) offered for contract hire/leasing under ESPO 218_26, bid on both 60-month and 84-month contract hire profile periods. Six scored vehicle specifications (Specs 1-6) plus one information-only specification (Spec 7). Usage profile 10,000 miles per annum, fully maintained, monthly payments in advance.
requirements: Tenderers must price both 60-month and 84-month contract hire profile periods for at least one vehicle specification per elected Lot; pricing for only one of the two periods renders the bid non-compliant for that specification.

Pricing is total on-the-road (OTR) and inclusive of vehicle and associated equipment, mileage/hours usage, maintenance and parts, scheduled manufacturer servicing, MOT (where required), handbooks, statutory fees (first registration fee, VED) and other regulatory duties excluding VAT.
Pricing is on a contract hire basis with monthly payments in advance; usage profile is 10,000 miles per annum.
Tendered pricing shall be inclusive of the 1% ESPO framework fee.
A vehicle weighting is applied per specification to build the total weighted basket price used for scoring.

evaluation_criteria.summary: Price evaluated per lot via the total weighted price for a basket of vehicle specifications, with vehicle-specific weightings applied. Maximum scored price weighting is 20% per the Overall Total Weighted Basket Price line, with detailed award criteria defined in the Invitation to Tender, section 5 - Evaluation of Tenders.
evaluation_criteria.weighting_text: Overall Total Weighted Basket Price (scored, max. score 20%)

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: Overall Total Weighted Basket Price (scored, max. score 20%)

evaluation_criteria.criterion: Median substitution for missing vehicle specifications
evaluation_criteria.summary: Where a tenderer submits compliant prices for some but not all vehicle specifications in a lot, the median of other compliant tenderers' prices is substituted for evaluation; if no tenderer bids on a specification it is removed from the evaluation.

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: the median price of all other compliant Tenderers' prices for the missing vehicle specifications will be used in substitution for evaluation purposes
